variants.statement: Find the principal argument of $z = 1 + i$, where $-\pi < \arg z \le \pi$.

forms.title: Probability without replacement
forms.skill: Update both counts after each draw.

variants.statement: Let $f(x) = \dfrac{x + 1}{x^2 + 1}$. Find $f'(2)$.
variants.explanation: Quotient rule: $f'(x) = \dfrac{1(x^2 + 1) - (x + 1) \cdot 2x}{(x^2 + 1)^2}$; at $x = 2$ the numerator is $-7$ and the denominator $25$, so $f'(2) = -\frac{7}{25}$. Reversing the numerator's two terms flips the sign — the order $u'v - uv'$ is the whole rule.
